hints.title: State Tracking per Index
hints.text: Maintain minimum swaps needed up to the current index under two conditions: keeping or swapping the pair.

hints.title: Transition Compatibility Cases
hints.text: Check if consecutive elements are naturally increasing, cross-increasing, or both.

hints.title: State Update Logic
hints.text: When naturally increasing, propagate keep to keep and swap to swap. When cross-increasing, propagate swap to keep and keep to swap plus one.

complexity.notes: State machine maintaining two variables across linear sequence traversal.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Recursively testing all 2^N swap decisions incurs exponential time complexity.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Constant auxiliary space O(1) rolling variables over O(N) array storage.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Identify the two mutually exclusive/inclusive ordering criteria and transition states accordingly.
